data.title: Chainsaw Man: Buddy Stories
data.native_title: チェンソーマン バディ・ストーリーズ
data.description:
Power lives out her favorite anime by becoming a genius detective—or so she wants her “audience” to believe! Denji is along for the ride as her assistant for an investigation into disappearances at a mountain hotel. Other stories center on Quanxi and Kishibe’s relationship nine years after they met, Himeno and Aki’s first assignment together, and Denji, Power, and Aki’s dream trip to Enoshima. 

(Source: VIZ Media)

data.title: Tatsuki Fujimoto Before Chainsaw Man: 22-26
data.description:
Killer mermaids, gender swapping, and a devilish little sister with the power to end the world—four more unforgettable short stories that reveal the starting point of Tatsuki Fujimoto, the twisted mastermind behind *Chainsaw Man*.

(Source: VIZ Media) 

1. **Mermaid Rhapsody** (人魚ラプソディ); 2014
2. **Woke-Up-as-a-Girl Syndrome** (目が覚めたら女の子になっていた病); 2017
3. **Nayuta of the Prophecy** (予言のナユタ); 2015
4. **Sisters** (妹の姉); 2018

data.description:
Alien invasions, high school romances, and even bloody vampire action—all this and more awaits in four compelling short stories that reveal the starting point of Tatsuki Fujimoto, the twisted mastermind behind *Chainsaw Man*. 

(Source: VIZ Media) 

Compilation containing four of Fujimoto's one-shots. 

1. **A Couple Clucking Chickens Were Kickin’ in the Schoolyard** (庭には二羽ニワトリがいた。); 2011
2. **Sasaki Stopped a Bullet** (佐々木くんが銃弾止めた); 2013
3. **Love Is Blind** (恋は盲目); 2013
4. **Shikaku** (シカク); 2014
